title: App Store app preview, iPhone 6.9"/6.5"/6.3"/6.1" (886x1920)
description: App previews for the iPhone display sizes that accept 886x1920 (portrait) or 1920x886 (landscape). Apple's published H.264 requirements, plus a loudness target and a 25 fps lower bound, both conservative conventions that only warn.

sources.title: Apple Developer: App Store Connect Help, App preview specifications

notes: Apple lists separate accepted resolutions per display size: 5.5" and 4" iPhones take 1080x1920, 4.7" takes 750x1334. Extend this profile and change video.size for those (see examples/profiles).
Apple publishes a 30 fps maximum but no minimum. The 25 fps lower bound is a conservative choice and only warns.
Apple's 10-12 Mbps is a target for H.264, so the bitrate rule only warns. It is checked on the whole file, with about 2% slack on each side.
Apple also accepts ProRes 422 HQ in .mov (about 220 Mbps). ProRes previews will get bitrate warnings from this profile.
Apple's stereo can also be two mono tracks; this tool checks only the first audio stream, so that layout is reported as 1 channel.

bitrate.total.note: Apple's target is 10-12 Mbps for H.264.

video.rotation.note: Bake rotation into the pixels; do not rely on App Store Connect honouring rotation metadata.

video.fps.note: Apple: max 30 fps. The 25 fps lower bound is a conservative convention.

audio.present.note: Observed 2026-09 (developer reports): Apple's spec describes a stereo audio track, and developers widely report that uploads without an audio track fail. Add silence if the preview has no sound.

audio.codec.note: PCM is listed for ProRes previews.

audio.loudness.note: Apple publishes no loudness target; -16 LUFS is a common mobile target.

audio.hiss.note: Observed 2026-10: a heuristic calibrated on game-trailer mixes, not a platform rule; see docs/checks.md#audiohiss.
